assets.author: Nomadik Footprints
assets.credit: Vimeo: Japan: from the North to the South - 北から南へ - (view archived source)
assets.description: #Japan #Hokkaido # #Nomadikfootprints #AlexandrePajaud #Tokyo Hi everyone, Today, I am taking you to The Land of the Rising Sun: Japan! A fantastic country divided into different prefectures, which are divided into 8 different regions. I will show a quick view of what you can find and expect: Hokkaido in winter, Tokyo in summer and Nagasaki in autumn. I started my journey in the northernmost part of the archipelago, in the freezing winter of Hokkaido. Small fishing towns, lovely people there, with amazing ramen, this island is magic by its scenery. I then moved to Tokyo, temples and neon streets at nights, Tokyo is a mix of future and past, within the same city. Tokyo has so much to offers, whatever you are looking for. Nagasaki, in the very south of the country, just before the Okinawa islands is full of history and little streets, that will satisfy your taste buds. I hope you will enjoy this quick over look of Japan! - Itinerary: Wakkanai, Asahikawa, Haboro (Hokkaido) Tokyo, Kamakura, (Kanto) Nagasaki (Kyushu) - Filmed with DJI Osmo Pocket & DJI Mavic Pro Drone - Edited with FCPX Follow me on Instagram and Vimeo @Nomadik_Footprints
